requirements.text: Start on https://quotes.toscrape.com/ and perform the three steps (open tag "love" from the tag list, go to its second page, open the first quote's author's about page) as plain-word AI instructions, not selectors, with a model actually usable on the first run (configured model and credentials).
Before returning, confirm without a model that the page reached has an address starting with https://quotes.toscrape.com/author/, and fail otherwise.
Return (output) the author's name, birth date and birthplace.
Keep what the model resolved for each step in a file next to the program, whatever the working directory.
A second run repeats the same steps, and reads the fields, with no model call at all, replaying from the kept file.
When the site changes so one kept step no longer applies, only that step goes back to the model, and the program says which step it was.
Release what it opens (connection/Run or Stagehand and its browser) and surface failures as errors rather than continuing silently.

api_misuses.member: process.env GOODFETCH_AI_MODEL (read by the program to pick ai.model)
api_misuses.assumed: a free environment variable the program may define for its own use
api_misuses.doc_says: ConnectOptions.env: connect() reads the process environment and an unknown GOODFETCH_ name fails with setting_unknown, so setting this variable would make connect() fail (the default path, unset, works)

programs.notes: Model set at the connection, Plan path made relative to the working directory from the program's own folder as the doc requires, compiled extract, URL Success check, and repaired steps reported by instruction. Only blemish is the self-invented GOODFETCH_ override variable.

api_misuses.assumed: a model is available for the first run's act/extract calls and for Repairs
api_misuses.doc_says: ai.model has no default: no model is called unless one is configured; a call the Plan holds no entry for raises ModelNotConfiguredError, and a drifted step with no model raises PlanDriftError

programs.notes: Otherwise well structured (Plan next to the file, URL check, repair reporting, PlanDriftError handled), but no model is configured anywhere, so the first run fails at the first act and no Plan is ever written to replay.

api_misuses.assumed: the Plan file lands next to the source file
api_misuses.doc_says: the Plan file path is relative to the working directory; file!() is relative to the compiling workspace root, so the file is next to the program only when run from that directory

programs.notes: Model set on the Run (from QUOTES_MODEL or a default), three act steps, URL Success check, compiled extract, repaired steps printed and drift/missing errors named. The Plan location depends on the working directory, unlike the golden's CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR path.

Keeps act's resolved Actions in a versioned file next to the program, replays them with selfHeal off, checks each step's URL so even a still-resolving changed element is caught, re-sends only the failed step to the model and names it, reads fields with selectors, checks the author URL, and closes Stagehand and the browser.

Model set on the Run, Plan path absolute next to the program, per-step and final URL Success checks plus a plain string check, compiled extract, and steps resolved by the model or repaired reported by name.
Sync API with ai.model in the Run settings, Plan file next to the module, URL Success checks after each step, compiled extract, repaired steps listed; Run closed in finally and connection via with.

api_misuses.assumed: a model is available for the first run's act/extract calls and for Repairs
api_misuses.doc_says: ai::MODEL: no default, no model is called unless one is configured; an unplanned call fails with model_not_configured and a drifted step with plan_drift

programs.notes: Careful step bookkeeping, URL checks and repair reporting, but no model is configured, so the first run fails at the first act and nothing is ever kept or replayed.

api_misuses.assumed: the provider key is read from OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment
api_misuses.doc_says: Stagehand 4.2.1 runs inference in its extension service worker, whose loadApiKey reports that environment variables are not supported there; the key must be passed as model.apiKey, so every model act fails

api_misuses.assumed: also closes the launched local browser
api_misuses.doc_says: close() only releases Stagehand's claim on the browser (closeTransport: false); the StagehandBrowser from localBrowser.launch() needs its own close(), which the program never calls

programs.notes: The replay design (kept Actions by step id, selfHeal off, URL check per step, only the failed step re-resolved and named) is sound, but with no API key passed the first run's model acts fail, so nothing is resolved or kept; the launched Chrome is also never closed.
